text:
# listing.category

TL;DR:
- listing.category is the expanded category entity for the listing.

What it means:
- It provides the resolved category context, not just a stable id.
- It is useful for explaining what product space the listing belongs to.

Agent hint:
- Prefer the expanded category object over categoryId when summarizing results for a user. See zbav://mcp/entity/category for full entity context.
